evidence.summary: Exhaustive sweep over all 63488 finite FP16 values shows the polynomial branch (|x| <= 1.05) violates the 1e-6 absolute tolerance: 16 inputs exceed it, worst at x=1.0498046875 (the largest FP16 value <= 1.05), where the kernel outputs 0.91615450 while the FP64 reference asinh is 0.91615603, an absolute error of 1.5232e-06 > 1e-6. This confirms the polynomial approximation error near the branch seam exceeds the contract tolerance.

rationale: The degree-9 polynomial (coefficients on lines 18-25) is an approximation of asinh on [0,1.05]; with FP32 Horner rounding and no fusion, its intrinsic error plus evaluation rounding may exceed 1e-6 somewhere in the interval, especially near the 1.05 seam where the outer branch takes over.

scope_evidence.summary: Every output element must satisfy abs(actual[i] - asinh(x[i])) <= 1e-6, relative tolerance zero, for the entire legal domain (all finite FP16 values).

scope_rationale: The contract requires abs error <= 1e-6 for every legal finite FP16 input, including values in [0,1.05] where the polynomial branch is used; the whole legal domain is explicitly in-scope with a single verdict.
statement: The polynomial branch (|x| <= 1.05) exceeds the 1e-6 absolute tolerance for some finite FP16 input in [0,1.05], particularly near the branch point |x| ≈ 1.05 where approximation and FP32 Horner cancellation errors are largest.

data.stdout: {"metric": "max_abs_error vs FP64 asinh, exhaustive over all finite FP16 values, outer log branch subset", "tolerance": 1e-06, "n_outer_branch": 32664, "outer_max_abs_err": 5.679616030818124e-07, "outer_worst_input": 1524.0, "outer_worst_ref": 8.022241024445623, "outer_worst_out": 8.022241592407227, "outer_count_over_tol": 0, "outer_err_just_above_seam_(1.05,2)": 1.3043092739195572e-07, "outer_err_large_(>1000)": 5.679616030818124e-07, "err_at_65504": 3.2526819104816695e-07}

evidence.summary: Exhaustive sweep over all finite FP16 values shows the outer log branch (|x| > 1.05) never exceeds the 1e-6 absolute tolerance: 0 of 32664 inputs violate it; max error is 5.680e-07 (at x=1524, output 8.02224159 vs ref 8.02224102), just above the seam (1.05,2) max is 1.30e-07, and at |x|=65504 the error is 3.25e-07. The FP32 tl.log/tl.sqrt evaluation stays within tolerance across the entire legal outer-branch domain.

rationale: log(|x|+sqrt(1+x^2)) in FP32 has ~2-3 ulp error, each rounding ~6e-8 near value ~0.88 but amplified by the log argument rounding; at moderate magnitudes (x ~ tens to hundreds) the argument is large and small relative errors in the argument become absolute errors in log comparable to 1e-6. Also there may be a mismatch/jump at the 1.05 seam between polynomial and outer evaluations.

scope_evidence.summary: Fixed absolute tolerance 1e-6 with zero relative tolerance applies throughout the entire legal domain, all finite FP16 values including large magnitudes up to +/-65504.

scope_rationale: All finite FP16 values including 1.05 < |x| <= 65504 are explicitly legal inputs, and the contract fixes a single 1e-6 absolute tolerance with zero relative tolerance for every element.
statement: The outer branch log(|x| + sqrt(1+x^2)) computed in FP32 with tl.log/tl.sqrt exceeds 1e-6 absolute error for some |x| > 1.05, either just above the seam (~1.05-2) due to accumulated FP32 rounding, or at large magnitudes where asinh grows to ~11.78 and FP32 ulp (~1e-6) plus Triton lg2-based log error exceeds the tolerance.
